name: Tenant offboarding archive stuck
query: N/A — count of platform.tenants where lifecycle_state='archived' AND archive_checksum IS NULL AND archived_at < now() - interval '24h'. No such gauge is emitted by anything shipped in Phase 5/6/7.
threshold: > 0 (any tenant stuck awaiting physical archival for more than 24h)
notes: Phase 7 sets lifecycle_state='archived' via the daily beat; the infra-side pipeline (infra/offboarding/archive.sh) then pg_dumps the schema and fills archive_checksum. If that host-side job is broken (missing age/aws creds, S3 outage, container gone), tenants pile up in archived+checksum-null and are never physically dumped — a silent failure with no in-app signal. Making this real needs a new sacco_ gauge (e.g. sacco_offboarding_archive_pending{age_bucket}) emitted on the observability beat by a query against platform.tenants, OR a systemd OnFailure hook on offboarding-archive.service that posts to Logfire. Staged here so the gap is tracked; see docs/alert-runbooks/offboarding-archive-stuck.md.
